Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misidentified Robert Erskine Childers as “Irish-born,” conflating national/political identity with birthplace. This confusion led to a later inversion of the sourced facts (treating Henry Roth as English-born and Childers as born in Galicia) and the incorrect final conclusion that Henry Roth was from England.
